experience.company: CeADAR – Ireland's National AI Research Centre
bullets: Engineered end-to-end RAG pipeline (Qdrant vector DB + Qwen LLM on Google Cloud TPU VMs) for AIRRVie, an AI-powered agricultural assistant; applied geospatial feature engineering to enrich location-aware queries.
Built LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation pipeline (Claude Haiku + Langfuse) to score and filter a 10,000+ record Vietnamese agricultural QA dataset, structuring entity relationships in Neo4j knowledge graphs.
Reduced end-to-end LLM response latency by ~35% via max_tokens tuning, streaming optimisation, and fixing a Qwen timeout truncation bug; ensured data quality and reliability across pipeline outputs.

Resolved PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion under 50+ concurrent users through load balancing; built network latency profiler benchmarking FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Qdrant (~120ms baseline), and Qwen TPU across 5 concurrency levels.
Diagnosed HTTP/gRPC protocol mismatch causing TPU health probe failures, restoring full service observability.
Built and maintained REST APIs using C#, Python, and .NET MVC, including request validation, error-response design, and integration with PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MongoDB.
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access controls to secure internal enterprise modules across multiple database backends.
Developed Flask backends with custom middleware for logging, error handling, and consistent API response contracts across microservices.

Automated data workflows with Power BI and SQL, boosting operational efficiency and real-time analytics capabilities by 15%; designed interactive KPI dashboards tracking production output, defect trends, and shift-level performance.
Applied predictive modelling and statistical analysis (SPSS) to forecast operational risks, enabling informed business decisions for ops leadership.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams on AWS cloud platforms to deliver data-driven insights for critical production projects.
Built multi-source data ingestion pipelines (Python, Pandas, SQL) and scikit-learn classification models for behavioural risk detection, improving analytics throughput by 10%.
Automated reporting workflows to improve operational efficiency and ensure data quality and compliance across business units.
